content.title: Arvada Reservoir
content.summary: Arvada-Blunn Reservoir will be closed on June 13, July 13, and August 17 for special events and invasive species treatments. The reservoir operates daily from April 1 to October 31, from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m., and requires passes for entry, which can be purchased online or at the site. Fishing is permitted, but certain activities like paddle boarding are prohibited, and all boats must undergo inspections before use.
content.body:
## Reservoir Closures

The Arvasda-Blunn Reservoir will be closed on the following days:

- **Saturday, June 13 until 1:30 p.m.** for the 26th annual Arvada Kids Fishing Contest
- **Monday, July 13** all day for watermilfoil invasive aquatic plant species treatments
- **Monday, Aug. 17** all day for watermilfoil invasive aquatic plant species treatments

![A recreational walking path that goes alongside a reservoir ](/ImageRepository/Document?documentID=3558 "A recreational walking path that goes alongside a reservoir ")

## Reservoir Hours and Dates of Operation

Arvada-Blunn Reservoir is located in west Arvada, [north of W 66th Ave. and east of Highway 93](https://goo.gl/maps/pCtZT9NATsm1kwt79). The reservoir is open daily from April 1 to October 31, from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m.

**Please Note**: The reservoir is subject to closure during inclement weather.

## Arvada Reservoir Passes

Arvada Reservoir passes are available to purchase online through the City's [online reservation system, CivicRec](https://secure.rec1.com/CO/arvada-co/catalog/index?filter=c2VhcmNoPSZjYXRlZ29yeSU1QjI5MTU4JTVEPTEmcmVudGFsJTVCZnJvbSU1RD0mcmVudGFsJTVCdG8lNUQ9JjQ1NzBkMmJkZGM1OTdkODQzMmFiYTc2NWYyM2YzNDM5PTY2MjRiZmRkNzgyOTM5M2ZmMjk1MGRkOTE5YTg2NWIy). Once you're on CivicRec, look for the red tab titled "Arvada Reservoir Passes."

Daily passes can be purchased online on the day of your visit between April 1 through October 31. Please complete your credit card purchase online prior to visiting the reservoir.

- Be sure to save your confirmation email as your receipt of purchase.
- Cash payments will be accepted at the reservoir.

[Purchase Passes](https://secure.rec1.com/CO/arvada-co/catalog/index?filter=c2VhcmNoPSZjYXRlZ29yeSU1QjI5MTU4JTVEPTEmcmVudGFsJTVCZnJvbSU1RD0mcmVudGFsJTVCdG8lNUQ9JjQ1NzBkMmJkZGM1OTdkODQzMmFiYTc2NWYyM2YzNDM5PTY2MjRiZmRkNzgyOTM5M2ZmMjk1MGRkOTE5YTg2NWIy)

## Annual User Pass

| Annual User Pass | Arvada Resident | Non-Resident |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Per Vehicle | $25 | $35 |
| Per Boat | $25 | $35 |

## Seniors 62 & Older & Disabled Pass

| Annual User Pass | Arvada Resident | Non-Resident |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Per Vehicle | $15 (Veteran price) | $25 |
| Per Boat | $15 (Veteran price) | $25 |

Annual fishing permits for second or more vehicles or boats owned by the same person may be purchased at 50% of the cost, but must be purchased at the same time that the original permit is purchased.

## Day Passes

| Day Passes | Fee |
| --- | --- |
| Vehicle (fishing) | $5 |
| Boat (fishing) | $5 |
| Bicyclist (fishing) | $3 |
| Walk-In (fishing) | $3 |
| Walk-In or Bicyclist | No Charge |

## Reservoir Details

- Open Hours April 1 to October 31: 7 am to 7 pm
- The Reservoir is located between Highway 93 and Indiana on W. 64th Parkway.
- [Download the Allowable Watercraft Document (PDF)](/DocumentCenter/View/906).
  - All boats must stay 150 feet away from the shoreline.
  - Paddle Boarding is **not**permitted on Arvada Reservoir.
  - Arvada Reservoir is Arvada’s drinking water supply; therefore, stand-up paddle boarding is not allowed due to the high potential for body contact and for safety purposes as the relatively small size of the reservoir has a higher potential for E. Coli, the primary concern when body contact sports are allowed.
- Dogs are **not**allowed.
- Persons under 16 years of age may not use a water vessel without an adult present in the vessel.
- Ranger Station phone number: 303-420-7773.

## Boat Inspections

Boats to be used on Arvada Reservoir are required to pass a boat inspection. Boat inspections are available on-site at the reservoir starting April 1.

## Contact

General reservoir questions: Parks Supervisor Ken Billips, 720-898-7415; Ranger Coordinator Mike McDonnell, 720-990-1954 or [email Arvada Reservoir](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#2b4a595d4a4f4a594e584e595d4442596b4a595d4a4f4a0544594c).
